high_level_description: This image captures a breathtaking aerial view of a mountainous landscape, showcasing a striking contrast between two distinct geological formations. The left side of the image features a vibrant, multi-colored mountain with layers of red, orange, yellow, green, and brown hues, suggesting the presence of minerals or rock formations that have been exposed over time. This colorful mountain is partially covered with snow, adding to its dramatic appearance. The right side of the image presents a stark white, snow-covered mountain, which appears to be more uniform in color and texture.
